Destination.description_en:
The destination address in the access control policy of the DNS border firewall. Valid values:

If DestinationType is set to `net`, the value of Destination is the destination CIDR block.

If DestinationType is set to `domain`, the value of Destination is the destination domain name.

If DestinationType is set to `group`, the value of Destination is the name of the destination address book
Destination.description_zh:
DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略中的目的地址。取值：

当DestinationType为`net`时，Destination为目的CIDR地址。

当DestinationType为`domain`时，Destination为目的域名。

当DestinationType为`group`时，Destination为目的地址簿名称

DestinationAddrs.description_en: The list of addresses in the destination address book
DestinationAddrs.description_zh: 目的地址簿的地址列表

items.description_en: The list of addresses in the destination address book
items.description_zh: 目的地址簿的地址列表

DestinationGroupType.description_en:
The type of the destination address book in the access control policy. Valid values:

ip: IP address book, which contains one or more CIDR blocks
domain: domain name address book, which contains one or more domain names
DestinationGroupType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址簿类型。取值：

ip：IP地址簿，包含一个或多个IP地址段。
domain：域名地址簿，包含一个或多个域名地址

DestinationType.description_en:
The type of the destination address in the access control policy. Valid values:

net: destination CIDR block
group: destination address book
domain: destination domain name
location: destination region
DestinationType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的目的地址类型。取值：

net：目的网段（CIDR）
group：目的地址簿
domain：目的域名
location：目的区域

Direction.description_en:
The traffic direction of the access control policy. Valid values:

in: inbound traffic
out: outbound traffic

访问控制策略的流量方向。取值：

in：外对内流量访问控制
out：内对外流量访问控制

HitLastTime.description_zh: 最新命中时间戳。使用秒级时间戳格式表示

HitTimes.description_zh: 访问控制策略的命中次数

4: IPv4

IpVersion.description_zh:
支持的IP地址版本。取值：

Priority.description_en: The priority of the access control policy. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
Priority.description_zh: 访问控制策略优先级。数字越小，优先级越高

Release.description_en:
The status of the access control policy. By default, the policy is enabled after it is created. Valid values:

true: Enabled

false: Disabled
Release.description_zh:
访问控制策略的启用状态。策略创建后默认启用该策略。取值：

true：启用访问控制策略

false：不启用访问控制策略

Source.description_en:
The source address in the access control policy. Valid values:

If SourceType is set to `net`, the source address is a CIDR block. Example: 192.0.XX.XX/24.
If SourceType is set to `group`, the source address is the name of the source address book. Example: db_group.
If SourceType is set to `location`, the source address is an area. For more information about the specific area positional encoding, see [AddControlPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138867.html）. Example: ["BJ11", "ZB"]
Source.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的访问源地址。取值：

当SourceType为`net`时，访问源为CIDR格式的IP地址段。例如：192.0.XX.XX/24。
当SourceType为`group`时，访问源地址为源地址簿名称。例如：db_group。
当SourceType为`location`时，访问源地址为区域（具体区域位置编码请参见[AddControlPolicy]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/138867.html））。例如： ["BJ11", "ZB"]

SourceGroupType.description_en:
The type of the source address book in the access control policy. Valid values:

ip: IP address book, which contains one or more CIDR blocks.

tag: ECS tag-based address book, which contains the IP addresses of one or more ECS tags.

domain: domain name address book, which contains one or more domain names.

threat: threat intelligence address book, which contains one or more malicious IP addresses or domain names.

backsrc: back-to-origin address book, which contains the back-to-origin IP addresses of one or more Anti-DDoS or WAF instances
SourceGroupType.description_zh:
访问控制策略中的源地址簿类型。取值：

ip：IP地址簿，包含一个或多个IP地址段。

tag：ECS标签地址簿，包含一个或多个ECS标签下的IP地址。

domain：域名地址簿，包含一个或多个域名地址。

threat：威胁地址簿，包含一个或多个恶意IP或域名地址。

backsrc：回源地址簿，包含一个或多个DDoS防护实例或WAF实例的回源地址

SourceType.description_en:
The type of the source address in the access control policy of the DNS border firewall. Valid values:

net: source CIDR block
group: source address book
SourceType.description_zh:
DNS边界防火墙访问控制策略中源地址类型。取值：

net：源CIDR地址
group：源地址簿
